zh: 文件夹一层又一层，找一个文件，却总在来回切换。
en: Folders within folders. Finding one file means jumping back and forth.
title: 层层打开
subtitle: LOST IN FOLDERS

zh: 目录浮窗，把文件夹里的结构，展开在你眼前。
en: Folder Peek unfolds the structure of your folders, right beside your work.
title: 让结构浮现
subtitle: LET STRUCTURE SURFACE

zh: 你打开哪个资源管理器文件夹，它就跟随最前面的那个窗口。
en: It follows the frontmost File Explorer folder window.
title: 你切换，它跟随
subtitle: FOLLOW YOUR FOCUS

zh: 从项目资料切到交付文件，目录树也随之更新。
en: Switch from project assets to deliverables, and the tree updates with you.
title: 同一个窗口 · 新的位置
subtitle: SAME WINDOW. NEW PLACE.

zh: 从根目录到子文件夹，再到具体文件，关系沿着分支逐层展开。
en: From the root to subfolders and individual files, each branch reveals a relationship.
title: 一条分支，一层关系
subtitle: A TREE OF RELATIONSHIPS

zh: 不同层级用不同颜色区分，每一行，只呈现一个名称。
en: Colors distinguish folder levels. Each entry gets its own line.
title: 层级，一眼分明
subtitle: DEPTH, AT A GLANCE

zh: 即使文件夹里有六十个文件，也先显示总数，默认展开前五项。
en: Even with sixty files, you see the total and just five entries to begin with.
title: 60 个文件，先看 5 个
subtitle: SIXTY FILES. FIVE TO START.

zh: 需要更多时，再点展示更多，每次追加五项，也可以调整数量。
en: Choose Show more to reveal five more at a time, or change the page size.
subtitle: REVEAL AT YOUR PACE

zh: 双击文件夹，就能聚焦这个分支；按住控制键点击，可以在资源管理器中打开或定位。
en: Double-click to focus a folder. Ctrl-click to open or locate it in File Explorer.
title: 从全局，到细节
subtitle: FROM OVERVIEW TO DETAIL

zh: 按住鼠标中键拖动画布，滚轮移动，控制键加滚轮缩放。
en: Middle-drag to pan, use the wheel to scroll, and Ctrl-wheel to zoom.
title: 视野，跟着你的手
subtitle: MOVE THROUGH THE MAP

zh: 选择文件夹、返回上一级、刷新，都在手边；展开深度，也由你决定。
en: Choose a folder, go up, refresh, and decide how many levels to expand.
title: 少一点操作，多一点清晰
subtitle: LESS FRICTION. MORE CLARITY.

zh: 开启窗口置顶，让目录留在工作旁边；也能随时暂停自动跟随。
en: Keep the window on top beside your work, or pause automatic following at any time.
title: 留在工作旁边
subtitle: STAY BESIDE YOUR WORK

zh: 白天清爽，夜晚沉静；轻点太阳或月亮，就能切换明暗模式。
en: Clear by day, calm by night. Tap the sun or moon to switch themes.
title: 日间 / 夜间
subtitle: LIGHT / DARK

zh: 中文宋体，英文新罗马，配合方角按钮和清晰的层级颜色。
en: SimSun for Chinese, Times New Roman for English, with square controls and clear depth colors.
title: 字体，有自己的秩序
subtitle: TYPE WITH INTENTION

zh: 点击路径下的三角，隐藏名称、按钮和路径，把空间留给目录树。
en: Tap the triangle below the path to hide the header and give the space to the tree.
title: 收起顶部，保留全貌
subtitle: HIDE THE HEADER. KEEP THE TREE.

zh: 一点九兆左右的安装包，中文、英文两种版本，轻装来到你的电脑。
en: An installer of about 1.9 megabytes, available in Chinese and English.
title: 轻装上场
subtitle: SMALL BY DESIGN

zh: 这份清晰，来自三个步骤：识别窗口、读取目录、绘制分支。
en: This clarity comes from three steps: identify the window, read the folder, draw the branches.
title: 它如何做到？
subtitle: HOW DOES IT WORK?

zh: 程序定期检查窗口顺序，只寻找可见、没有最小化的资源管理器。
en: It checks window order periodically, looking for visible, non-minimized File Explorer windows.
title: 只关注文件夹窗口
subtitle: ONLY FILE EXPLORER

zh: 再通过系统接口，确认活动文件夹的真实路径，而不是猜测窗口标题。
en: Windows shell interfaces provide the active folder path instead of guessing from the title.
title: 标题不是路径
subtitle: THE PATH, NOT A GUESS

zh: 拿到路径后，枚举当前目录里的项目，统计文件夹和文件的数量。
en: With the path identified, it enumerates that directory and counts its folders and files.
title: 读取这一层，统计这一层
subtitle: ENUMERATE. COUNT.

zh: 只保留需要显示的条目，再按设定深度展开；隐藏的分支，不会全部递归。
en: It keeps the entries needed for display and expands to the chosen depth, without traversing every hidden branch.
title: 按需展开，而非全部铺开
subtitle: EXPAND WHAT YOU NEED

zh: 目录读取放在后台；快速切换时，过期的结果会被丢弃。
en: Folder reads run in the background. When you switch quickly, stale results are discarded.
title: 新的位置，新的画面
subtitle: KEEP THE LATEST RESULT

zh: 最后，把层级映射成坐标和线条，再把拖动与缩放应用到画布。
en: Finally, hierarchy becomes coordinates and lines, with panning and zooming applied to the canvas.
title: 层级 → 坐标 → 分支
subtitle: HIERARCHY BECOMES GEOMETRY

zh: 这一切，在本地完成。无需上传你的目录，也不需要打开文件内容。
en: It all happens locally, without uploading your directory or opening file contents.
title: 目录，留在你的电脑
subtitle: YOUR FOLDERS STAY LOCAL

zh: 目录浮窗，让你少一点寻找，多一点看见。
en: Folder Peek. Less searching. More seeing.
title: 少一点寻找，多一点看见
subtitle: LESS SEARCHING. MORE SEEING.
